about_the_game:
Making critical decisions in football has never been this exciting! You will not watch the match roles in this match, you will make decisions like a referee: Penalty? Offside? Foul? Decide now, determine the fate of the match!

Carefully examine the positions taken from real match moments, carry your team to victory by making fast and correct decisions. It will both test your football knowledge and have adrenaline-filled moments. This game, full of funny and engaging moments, will sometimes be difficult to decide, and sometimes there will be fun involved.

What Awaits You in This Game?

The experience of watching realistic match positions and making decisions.

Analyzing critical football positions such as penalties, offsides, fouls.

Speed ​​and attention, daily exciting game moments.

Fun and animated simulation elements.

An atmosphere full of funny and unexpected football events.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce Gt 730
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!
